line_items.reasoning: Q3 revenue of $13.1B (up 47% YoY) puts AVGO firmly on track to exceed the raised FY2024 consolidated revenue guidance of $51B, with Q4 guidance implying a full-year run-rate above that figure.

Infrastructure software operating margin of 67% (69% ex-transition costs) and VMware OpEx reduction to $1.3B signal AVGO is tracking ahead of the 61% adjusted EBITDA margin target, with VMware on pace to exceed its own $8.5B EBITDA FY25 target early.

Full-year AI revenue guidance was raised again to $12B (from the prior >$11B), and non-AI networking recovered 17% sequentially in Q3, both exceeding the prior raised targets of >$11B AI revenue and 40% YoY networking growth.
Broadband declined 49% YoY in Q3 and is expected to remain down >40% YoY in Q4, materially worse than the already-lowered guidance of down high-30s% YoY.
Industrial resales fell 31% YoY in Q3 and are still expected down ~20% YoY in Q4, worse than the already-lowered guidance of down double-digit % YoY.
